messages:
Priya S: HelioChip reached out about a joint marketplace perf validation + kernel-tune pass. They want measurements focused on perf/W, steady-state throughput, and a short SI integration checklist so they can list a Redwood-backed SKU in their marketplace. Can we scope a two-phase run (dry-run + broad sweep) and an embargoed blog afterward?
Miguel L: Hi from HelioChip eng. We can provide 4 boards for dry-run and up to 12 for the sweep. We expose power telemetry, die temps, and package power. We'll also share a short HW spec sheet and the marketplace listing template.
Tom K: Proposed workloads: chat (batched streaming), completion (unbatched), and 768-embedding throughput. Seq targets: 128, 512, 1536. We'll test hot KV cache and cold-start.
Priya S: Include kernel flags we want to vary: attention_impl (naive|fused), block_size (64|128|256), and enable_packed_kv (0|1). Primary metrics: tokens/sec, avg_power_W, perf_per_W, p95_latency, sustained_throughput (10m window). Secondary: fan_rpm, VRAM_voltage.
Ewa P: BenchBot requirement: every run manifest must include `model_commit`, `runtime_version`, `kernel_commit`, `dataset_seed`, and `marketplace_sku` (if targeting marketplace). Missing fields cause rejection.
Aisha M: Marketing here  we need a draft positioning quidelines: no absolute perf numbers until HelioChip approves. Also want a 1-paragraph blurb + partner quote ready for sync. Can we get an embargo date?
Miguel L: HelioChip legal wants a 7-day review window post-results before any public asset. Embargo OK.
Tom K: Draft run command for validation (HelioChip sensors path differs):
```bash
./bench_runner \
  --model redwood-v2-base \
  --seq 1536 \
  --batch 4 \
  --quant int8-qat \
  --kernel-flags "attention=fused,block=128,packed_kv=1" \
  --sensors /sys/helio/power_stream \
  --run-tag helio-2026-sweep \
  --manifest /runs/helio-1536.json
```
Miguel L: Change `--sensors` to `/sys/helio/telemetry/power` on our infra. We will pre-provision SSH + ephemeral S3 bucket for logs.
Priya S: Can HelioChip also enable a controlled fan-profile? We want to exercise thermal headroom.
Miguel L: Yes, fan profiles available: normal|quiet|max. We'll run dry-run on `normal` and `quiet` to characterize.
Ewa P: BenchBot: queued dry-run job 39120 for 1767120000; will validate manifests and reject if metadata missing. Aggregation will produce CSV with kernel columns injected.
BenchBot: Scheduled job 39120 (dry-run) for 1767120000. Artifacts will land at: s3://redwood-shared/helio/39120.
Tom K: Aggregation columns to expect: run_id, model, seq_len, batch_size, quant, attention_impl, block_size, packed_kv, tokens_per_sec, avg_power_w, perf_per_w, p95_ms, peak_temp_c, fan_rpm, vram_v, manifest_hash.
Aisha M: For the marketplace listing we need: validated SKU name, recommended config (quant + kernel flags), expected cost-per-token estimate, and one-line compatibility note for SI integrators. Let's make `marketplace_sku` a manifest field.
Miguel L: We'll provide logos and a legal-approved quote after the embargo period. Also: can Redwood produce a short compatibility matrix for common SI stacks? We can include that in the HelioChip marketplace tile.
Priya S: Yes, product will produce compatibility table (Docker images, runtime versions, kernel_commit). Tom you ok to own the technical appendix for the public doc?
Tom K: I got it. I'll also include reproduction steps and the `fallback_policy` for OOM/thermal events (auto-retry at batch/seq reduction and auto-backoff).
Ewa P: Note on QA: include reproducibility checks (sha256 of model binary, dataset fingerprint). BenchBot will block runs where checksums don't match expected values.
Miguel L: Dry-run availability: Tue 09:30 PT. I've posted board IDs and SSH fingerprints at https://helio-share/boards-2026.
BenchBot: Dry-run job 39120 started 1767120000. Live stream: https://benchstream/redwood/39120
Tom K: Monitoring dry-run now. If green, we'll schedule full sweep Wed-Thu next week and invite SI partners to an integration demo Fri.
Aisha M: Marketing timeline: draft copy Wed evening, design assets Thu, review with HelioChip legal Fri. Plan go/no-go for blog publish 7 days after results.
Priya S: Approval owners: Priya (partner comms), Aisha (marketing), Tom (technical accuracy), Miguel (HelioChip sign-off). I'll create the run matrix and calendar invites now and tag legal for NDA checks. :calendar: :lock:
Miguel L: One technical ask  can Redwood include at least one baseline fp16 run for parity comparison? Helps our SI partners certify correctness.
Tom K: Yes, we'll include fp16 baseline + int8-qat variant. Expect longer run times for QAT.
Ewa P: Reminder to everyone  include `marketplace_sku` and `embargo_until` in the manifest. BenchBot will surface embargo metadata in result headers.
Priya S: Great work. Thanks team  I'll post the run matrix link and invite the SI integrators.
Miguel L: Thanks all, HelioChip looking forward to the runs.
BenchBot: Dry-run 39120 completed 1767123600. Aggregated CSV: s3://redwood-shared/helio/39120/aggregated.csv
Tom K: Review shows stable perf/W improvement vs baseline at target kernel flags. I'll open the full sweep and ping SI partners for Friday demo.
Aisha M: I'll draft partner-facing talking points and coordinate design for the marketplace tile.
Priya S: Filing minutes and next steps in https://redwood-internal/helio/bench-matrix. Closing thread for now."
